item.title: Implement SPEC.md rate limiter
item.brief: Implement the rate limiter described in SPEC.md in ratelimit.py, which currently has stubs. Follow SPEC.md exactly, including every error case and edge case; supplied test_ratelimit.py covers only basics, so derive and check additional cases from the spec. Keep dependency-free using only the Python standard library. Run the repository's relevant tests and spec-derived edge-case checks. Commit the completed work on the item branch. Acceptance: implementation behavior matches SPEC.md; tests/checks pass; commit exists; no third-party dependency added.

pr.body: Implemented TokenBucket and KeyedLimiter in ratelimit.py using only the Python standard library. Constructor and request validation includes non-finite settings; token accounting supports fractional refill and monotonic clock rollback; keyed calls update LRU usage and evicted keys restart full. Expanded test_ratelimit.py for invalid values, rollback, fractional refill, wait non-consumption, LRU behavior, and fresh buckets after eviction. Verification on final head: all 6 unittest cases passed, spec-derived edge checks passed, and git diff --check passed. No third-party dependencies added. No known gaps.
pr.summary: Implemented the specified token bucket and keyed LRU rate limiter. Before: constructing a bucket raised NotImplementedError; now requests refill continuously, honor waits and clock behavior, and keyed limits evict the least recently used bucket.
